preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in ' ' for c in input) == all(c not in return_value for c in input.replace(' ', ''))
postconditions.description: The output string is the input string with all spaces removed, preserving the order of all other characters.
The length of the output string equals the length of the input string with all spaces removed.
